outer_fits: leave each source RX out of L_s; score matching V RX
leave each source day out of L_s; score matching V day
fitting: L_s complement only for means, covariances, local responses and nested R prediction/reliability
covariance: packet within TX/day/RX + named L/T/trustedR + 1e-5 I160
local_response_prior: I8/6, original physical units and finite differences
R: inner held TX pair and held day, shrink=.4; original full-vector c=max(0,1-MSE/zero)
transform: unique symmetric full-rank covariance inverse square root; no hard projection
advancement: For every seed: macro held-RX V accuracy of primary strictly exceeds both packet and original parent; full-fit V loss vs parent <=0.2pp overall and <=0.5pp per RX; macro held-day V accuracy >= parent. No selection of other methods if primary fails.
budget: 3 seeds x9 outer fits x6 fixed metric readouts =162 analytic readouts; no identity training or target testing
